sections.appearance: Kirino has white, hip-length hair tied into two pigtails and blue eyes. Her hair frames her face with its bangs. Halo ==== Her halo represents a four-petal flower with a pinkish center that fades into light blue outwards, surrounded by a circle that intersects each of the flower's petals. Uniform ==== Kirino has the traditional outfit of a Japanese female police officer, along with the white overcoat and boots. She also has a gun strap to the left side of her chest holding a pistol, a purple arm band with Valkyrie's logo embedded on it on her left hand, several smoke grenades, a white bag, and a purple megaphone attached to her waist. Firearm ==== She utilizes a white Smith & Wesson Model 360 revolver with a blue grip. The KSPD logo can be seen on the grip. For her EX Skill, she uses an M7 CS Grenade.

sections.personality: Contrasting her partner Fubuki, Kirino is incredibly hardworking and hotblooded. She dreams of becoming an honorable police officer who protects and serves the people, but her own character flaws prevent this. She is too passionate in her work, willing to occasionally defy orders to try and do what is right... and proving exactly why she should have followed said orders due willingness to use extreme measures. Despite her ridiculously bad accuracy, Kirino is very adept in close-quarters combat through her swift reflexes and nimble movement, though she admit she's quick-feeted so she can finish her due quickly and taking a break as fast as possible. This close-quarters skill nevertheless managed to gain the respect of RABBIT-1, Tsukiyuki Miyako. In short, Kirino has the will, but not the skill.
